top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises the physiology of GLP-1 and identification of its active peptide form (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov), a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain that made incretin-based therapy for type 2 diabetes and obesity possible; the three-person allocation credits discovery-level steps and leaves long-acting analogue development to the citation's consequence clause. No award is clearly inferior given the maturity and impact of the work.
